description: Status and results of a find_creators search on this account: exact matches only (each with the quoted evidence for every must-have, why it fits, followers, typical views, days since last post, best video and how to reach them), how many were found, and the funnel (how many were found, active and checked). While the search runs it waits up to 45 seconds for it to finish (set wait_seconds, 0-50); call it again until status is done or failed.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for a running search to finish, 0-50. Default 45 over MCP, 0 over REST.
